question: The construction of Humayun's tomb was completed by:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biga Begum**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The construction of **Humayun's Tomb** was commissioned by his widow, **Biga Begum**, also known as **Haji Begum**.
 
• It was built in memory of the Mughal Emperor **Humayun** and is considered the first significant example of **Mughal architecture** in India.
 
• The tomb was designed by the Persian architect **Mirak Mirza Ghiyas**, reflecting the **Persian style of architecture** with Indian influences.
 
• The construction was completed in the year **1571**, about 15 years after Humayun's death in **1556**.
 
• It is located in **Delhi, India**, and is a UNESCO **World Heritage Site**.
 
• The complex is known for its **charbagh (four-part) garden layout**, which became a hallmark of Mughal gardens.
 
• **Red sandstone and white marble** were extensively used in its construction, showcasing the grandeur of the Mughal era.
 
• The structure served as inspiration for later Mughal monuments, including the **Taj Mahal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Zeenat Mahal**__

 __
 
• **Zeenat Mahal** was the wife of the last Mughal Emperor **Bahadur Shah Zafar**.
 
• She was known for her influence in the Mughal court during the declining years of the empire.
 
• She had no connection with the construction of **Humayun's Tomb**.
 
 
 
• **Mah Chuchak Begum**__
 __
 
• **Mah Chuchak Begum** was a wife of **Humayun** and played a political role during the Mughal reign.
 
• She was known for her governance in **Kabul** after Humayun's death.
 
• However, she was not involved in the construction of **Humayun's Tomb**.
 
 
 
• **Rahmat Banu Begum**__
 
 
• **Rahmat Banu Begum** was the daughter of **Humayun**.
 
• There is no historical evidence of her involvement in the construction of the tomb.
